title: NCERT twelve-case frozen AI review reference
author: James (AI inspector)
status: AI-authored answer/reasoning audit reference, not educational gold or prerequisite labels
scope_criteria: Evaluate numerical/algebra correctness, reasoning, assumptions, evidence grounding and scope separately; do not collapse into prerequisite accuracy.
Absence from selected excerpts or chapter-only context cannot establish full-curriculum prerequisite absence.
Worked examples may teach their method in their own solutions; pre-solution readiness is not equivalent to instructional adequacy.
Declared prior background is a study assumption, not proof of independently verified teaching history.
Citations must refer to actual supplied evidence IDs and support the claim; page identity alone is not entailment.
Never count uncited correct arithmetic as source-supported educational adequacy.
Equivalent algebra and correctly rounded values are acceptable; inspect units, sign, both roots and all subparts.
Missing assumptions and wrong reasoning can coexist with a correct numerical answer; report separately.
Do not penalize justified uncertainty where evidence is incomplete; identify whether a conditional numerical answer was still possible.
These12 convenience examples are not prevalence estimates or held-out validation; later manual audit remains AI unless a teacher participates.

audit_dimensions.evidence: supported / partly_supported / unsupported / absent; assess each citation

crucial_reasoning_checks: Expand and subtract RHS: i x^2-6*x+8; ii x+12; iii x^2+3*x-1; iv 6*x^2+12*x+12.
Judge simplified degree with nonzero quadratic coefficient, not displayed highest power before cancellation.
assumptions_to_recognize: Real coefficients; prior distributive arithmetic and identities.
evidence_quality_criteria: Section4.2 definition before target; earlier Example1 expansion.

crucial_reasoning_checks: Requested factorisation: correct quadratic-formula answer alone does not fully meet method instruction.
assumptions_to_recognize: ClassIX factorisation explicitly assumed; linear solving and zero-product property.
evidence_quality_criteria: Section4.3 root definition and ClassIX reference; do not cite target solution as earlier evidence.

crucial_reasoning_checks: (3*x-2)*(2*x+1)=0; both roots or equivalent verified algebra.
assumptions_to_recognize: Signed fractions and linear equation solving.
evidence_quality_criteria: Earlier Example3 factorisation and paragraph before Example4 on equating factors to zero.

crucial_reasoning_checks: Preserve sqrt(6) coefficient; root is positive, not plus/minus sqrt(2/3).
assumptions_to_recognize: Radical arithmetic and irrational-coefficient linear solving assumed; repeated-root interpretation may be taught in target solution.
evidence_quality_criteria: Earlier factorisation examples support method; no invented claim radicals or repeated roots explicitly taught in a provided span.

assumptions_to_recognize: Rectangle area and positive physical dimensions.
evidence_quality_criteria: Must locate earlier Section4.1 problem, not infer missing dimensions from target-only phrasing.

crucial_reasoning_checks: Negative D means no real roots, not no complex solutions.
evidence_quality_criteria: Section4.4 discriminant definition and sign classifications before target.

assumptions_to_recognize: Stated0.5A constant or time-average current over interval; minute-second conversion.
Magnitude requested; simple algebra and multiplication.
evidence_quality_criteria: Eq11.2 V=W/Q and volt definition; page4 target solution is not prior support.

assumptions_to_recognize: Given resistances apply at stated operating condition; division/rounding.
evidence_quality_criteria: Prior Ohm-law relation; do not demand detecting solution-only Eq12.6 typo. If claimed seen in input, verify actual supplied evidence.

expected_answer.condition: unchanged resistance15ohm, contextual constant-temperature Ohm-law idealization

crucial_reasoning_checks: Bare8A is numerically correct under idealization; separately mark assumption recognition absent if not stated.
A qualified answer giving8A conditionally and explaining underdetermination ifR varies is sound.
assumptions_to_recognize: Constant resistance; unchanged temperature/contextual idealization. Real heater heating can changeR; no temperature relation supplied.
evidence_quality_criteria: Ohm-law constant-temperature qualifier and resistance temperature dependence; ambiguity is not automatically a textbook defect.

crucial_reasoning_checks: Use supplied table at20C; manganese, not manganin.
assumptions_to_recognize: Uniform circular wire; circle area, SI conversions and powers.
evidence_quality_criteria: Eq11.10 resistance-resistivity relation and Table11.2; material identification based on supplied table, not independently validated material data.

expected_answer.condition: equal resistivity at matching material conditions

crucial_reasoning_checks: Area doubles; do not square area factor or confuse it with doubled diameter.
assumptions_to_recognize: Same material and matching temperature/material conditions imply equalrho.
evidence_quality_criteria: Eq11.10 and temperature dependence; same-material inference conditional on matching conditions.
